weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. Effective against flying foes. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd+6 to unit during combat, and also, if unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.

assist.d: Target ally moves to opposite side of unit.

b.d: If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Def/Res-2 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of both unit and target through their next actions.

If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Def/Res-4 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of both unit and target through their next actions.

If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Def/Res-6 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of both unit and target through their next actions.
